title: Belemus
summary: Raleigh names Belemus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Belemus, named with Mithridates and the rest, Presidents and Counsellors in Phoenicia, in the Epistle which Esdras remembreth. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter III, §. VII, sig. 401a
